anchor.note: DataLocal.list and DataLocal.pack are fully present in the verified InstallPack prefix used for this read-only audit.

rare_dataset.compatibility_interpretation: Presence in a local original R1 set is strong evidence that the original Rare Gacha data loader accepts that unit id. It is not yet proof of successful acquisition/duplicate save semantics for every unit.

rate_status.reason: InstallPack-local GatyaDataSet/Option/EventGatya files prove pool sets, rarity tiers, UI/options and chance-animation metadata, but do not themselves prove the live banner rarity probability vector.
rate_status.next_evidence: Capture one exact original JP 15.7.1 Rare Capsule banner/event configuration or runtime draw decision in Phase C before freezing Super Kneekura rates.

super_kneekura_pool_gate.phase_c_seed_pool: Start from the exact 495-unit local R1 union, then further restrict to units whose acquisition/duplicate behavior is observed safe.
super_kneekura_pool_gate.expansion_rule: Only add the remaining 169 Rare-through-Legend ids after exact historical/server R-set evidence or direct original acquisition-path proof.
super_kneekura_pool_gate.normal_special_policy: Keep Normal/Special/story-only units outside v1 until their nonstandard acquisition semantics are proven.
